title: Cinematic sequencing and accessible UI
robloxStudio: 0.746.0.7461269 observed on authoring workstation; recheck on replay
scenario: A client-only Field Notes reveal sequences readable title, location, and objective cues over the 3D scene. Persistent touch-sized Skip and Reduced Motion controls use GuiButton.Activated; reduced-motion mode shortens the shared rule timing without changing cue order, and completion leaves the objective visible.
expectedOutcomes: Cues play in order and complete within their timing boundaries.
Skip immediately reaches the objective state.
Reduced-motion mode reduces transition duration without removing information.
failureCases: A cue is interrupted by respawn.

targets.mobile: text readable at 320 px width; touch target >= 44 px
targets.desktop: keyboard and pointer access; reduced-motion setting respected

assets.source: Field Notes UI and sequence authored in projects/benchmark-cinematic-ui/src/client/CinematicIntro.client.luau. Audio synchronization remains unproven because external Roblox sound assets were not imported.

evidence.maturity: client implementation and offline sequence rules authored; live Studio visual, touch/controller, audio, and device review remain pending
